name: Stellar Performance
author: SilentHacks
description: Performance improvements for the inspected StellarDrive Demo 0.8.2 build: cached ship queries and cable topology, reduced redundant visual work, and native record reuse. Optional incremental room reconstruction and fixed-part mesh batching are experimental and disabled by default. Requires MelonLoader; SDModKit is optional. See the README for compatibility, settings and validation limits.
